display.purpose: Mistr identity and concise panel titles without novelty letterforms.

numeric.purpose: Tabular time, freshness, position, and dBZ values.

shadows.name: instrument
shadows.purpose: Separates the compact control instruments from the map.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Separates the one open transient panel without creating a card hierarchy.

components.name: Radar Context Bar
components.description: The compact top-center identity and canonical searchable site selector.
components.css: .ds-context{height:40px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(8,11,18,.88);color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.44);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}.ds-context strong{font:600 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:0 9px}.ds-context button{height:30px;padding:0 10px;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:transparent;color:#F4F7FA;font:600 11px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-context button:hover,.ds-context button:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);outline:none}

components.name: Menu Trigger
components.description: The single small trigger for global application tools.
components.html: <button class="ds-menu-trigger" aria-label="Open Mistr menu"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 7h14M5 12h14M5 17h14"/></svg></button>

components.name: Compact Tool Menu
components.description: A compact grouped temporary menu with a conventional internal close control and no decorative accent rail.
components.css: .ds-tool-menu{width:286px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(8,11,18,.98);color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.54)}.ds-tool-menu header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.ds-tool-menu strong{font:600 16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.035em}.ds-tool-menu button{width:100%;min-height:50px;padding:8px;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:transparent;color:#F4F7FA;text-align:left;font:500 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-tool-menu button:hover,.ds-tool-menu button:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);outline:none}

components.name: Radar Site Browser
components.description: The single searchable browser for all 155 provider-qualified operational WSR-88D sites.
components.html: Radar sites155 WSR-88D STATIONS
components.css: .ds-site-browser{width:360px;max-height:calc(100vh - 154px);overflow:auto;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(8,11,18,.98);color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.54)}.ds-site-browser header{display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-site-browser input{height:36px;margin:12px 0 8px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:9px;background:#050506;color:#F4F7FA}.ds-site-browser button{width:100%;min-height:50px;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:transparent;color:#F4F7FA;text-align:left}

components.name: Playback Bar
components.description: The stable bottom-center control for observation time and playback truth.
components.html: <section class="ds-playback"><button aria-label="Play radar loop">▶</button><input aria-label="Displayed scan" type="range"><output>12:29:26 CDT · PAUSED · FRESH 00:41</output></section>

components.name: Measured Readout
components.description: A textual and numeric state block for observation truth.

components.name: Inspection Reticle
components.description: A map crosshair paired with a playback-bar dBZ readout rather than a floating tooltip.

narrative.overview: The radar is the stage. Four disciplined control zones frame it: radar context at the top, global tools at left, future alerts at right, and observation time at the bottom.

rules.name: The Weather Separation Rule
rules.body: Cyclorama color never overlays radar pixels or imitates weather severity.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: Only one side panel may be open and it never resizes the map.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Typography earns character through proportion, weight, and spacing rather than novelty letterforms.

dos: Keep each spatial zone responsible for one class of task.
Keep the canonical site browser searchable.
Keep temporary menus short and grouped.
donts: Do not build a permanent sidebar.
Do not duplicate the site picker.
Do not present fixed product or tilt facts as controls.
Do not add chains of side buttons.
Do not show alerts before alerts exist.
Do not wash radar with decorative color.
